optimizer.objective: Maximize the worst portfolio CAGR across the documented base and return-stress cases, then prefer higher base CAGR and lower DD, subject to robust risk guardrails.
optimizer.tieBreak: Higher base CAGR, then lower weighted historical DD.

robustMethod.label: Robust max-growth with dual guardrails

returnScenarios.label: Forecast stress: Money Market retains 90%; equity sleeves retain 75%
Fee and forecast miss: minus 0.50 point for cash and 1.50 points for equity

cdar.reason: A synchronized common-date official NAV series for every required sleeve is not yet reproducibly retrievable in the weekend pipeline. CDaR must not become a hard gate until that evidence gap closes.

robustMethod.modelDisclosure: Return stresses, the one-point reserve and the 60% concentration ceiling are portfolio-policy assumptions, not external factual claims. They are deliberately explicit and validated every weekend.

fundModels.forecastUse: No target fund: use the own-fund 4.00% gross scenario and deduct the complete 0.53% A PHP fee stack.
fundModels.feeBasis: A PHP KIID: 0.50% trust + 0.00% custody + 0.02% accounting + 0.01% audit + 0.00% other fees.

fundModels.forecastUse: Use the 10.61% Fidelity target-level forecast after its official 1.89% OCF, then deduct the complete 1.25% ATRAM A PHP wrapper and operating fee stack.
fundModels.feeBasis: ATRAM A PHP KIID wrapper: 1.23% trust + 0.01% accounting + 0.00% audit + 0.01% benchmark + 0.00% other = 1.25%. Fidelity's direct A-ACC-USD factsheet reports a 1.89% OCF.

fundModels.forecastUse: Use the actual UCITS target and JPM long-term assumptions for CAGR; U.S. JEPQ remains a historical drawdown proxy only.
fundModels.feeBasis: Target-based 10-year model: 30% x official UCITS target annualized total return 18.15% + 70% x JPM 2026 long-term U.S. large-cap return 6.70% = 10.135%; subtract the 0.245% non-embedded target-fee adjustment and complete 1.65% ATRAM A PHP fee stack.
fundModels.returnBasis: Actual target JPM Nasdaq Equity Premium Income Active UCITS ETF USD (dist), IE000U9J8HX9. JEPQ is excluded from CAGR and used only for historical DD.

fundModels.forecastUse: Use JPMorgan's 2026 AC Asia ex-Japan 10-15 year compound-return assumption of 7.90%, then deduct the exact target C (div) USD TER of 0.85% and the complete 1.30% ATRAM PHP wrapper fee stack.
fundModels.feeBasis: ATRAM KIID: 1.28% trust + 0.01% accounting + 0.00% audit + 0.01% benchmark + 0.00% other = 1.30%; exact target class JPMorgan Asia Equity Dividend C (div) USD, HK0000615358, TER 0.85%.
fundModels.returnBasis: JPM 2026 LTCMA AC Asia ex-Japan Equity compound return, mapped to the target fund's Asia-Pacific ex-Japan mandate.

macroModel.rateFormula: Weighted sum of the 3-, 6-, and 12-month model scores using 45%, 35%, and 20% horizon weights. Scores are model interpretations of official data, not observed facts or promises.
macroModel.selectionRule: Twelve non-overlapping drivers are retained because each has a distinct transmission channel, authoritative primary source, and non-zero allocation sensitivity to at least one required fund. Broader candidates are rejected when their portfolio effect duplicates an included policy, inflation, growth, financial-conditions, FX, earnings, semiconductor, valuation, or volatility channel.

drawdownModel.formula: Portfolio DD = sum(allocation weight x target-reference historical maximum DD). No forward-looking DD, blend, correlation adjustment, or diversification credit is used.

funds.historicalBasis: No target fund exists. Official ATRAM Peso Money Market Fund A PHP daily NAV maximum drawdown from 3,076 records, 16 Dec 2013 to 11 Aug 2026.
funds.historicalMetric: Own-fund historical daily NAV maximum drawdown

funds.historicalBasis: Official Fidelity Global Technology Fund A-ACC-USD, LU1046421795, daily NAV maximum drawdown from 3,203 observations, 9 Apr 2014 to 12 Aug 2026; peak 28.71 on 19 Feb 2020 and trough 19.62 on 18 Mar 2020.
funds.historicalMetric: Target-fund historical daily NAV maximum drawdown

funds.historicalBasis: Official U.S.-listed JPMorgan Nasdaq Equity Premium Income ETF, JEPQ CUSIP 46654Q203, daily raw-NAV maximum drawdown from 1,077 observations, 4 May 2022 to 19 Aug 2026; peak 19 Feb 2025 and trough 8 Apr 2025. Raw NAV is not distribution-adjusted; the actual UCITS target remains the CAGR basis.
funds.historicalMetric: JEPQ historical daily raw-NAV maximum drawdown proxy

funds.historicalBasis: Official JPMorgan Asia Equity Dividend accumulating USD target-reference share class, HK0000151818, daily NAV maximum drawdown from 3,247 observations, 31 May 2013 to 19 Aug 2026; peak 13.87 on 26 Jan 2018 and trough 8.88 on 23 Mar 2020. The accumulating class avoids distribution distortions; exact C (div) USD HK0000615358 remains the target fee basis.

regionalRankings.rationale: Resilient 4.9% regional growth and a strong North Asian semiconductor cycle outweigh higher energy and inflation risks.
Solid private demand and AI investment are offset by elevated inflation and a restrictive policy backdrop.
Weak growth and an energy-led inflation shock constrain the near term, with gradual improvement over 12 months.
